title: Caixa
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente no caixa e em outras áreas da farmácia caso seja necessário;
  • Efetuar a abertura e o fechamento do caixa de medicamentos;
  • Garantir o registro dos produtos;
  • Conferir e precificar produtos;
  • Realizar reposição dos itens nas seções da farmácia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar em escala 6x1.
  • Que Pode Ser Um Diferencial

Desejável experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios

  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Plataforma de terapia online;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GENTE QUE FAZ BEM!

Na história da Pague Menos , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Promover o acesso à saúde significa ampliar liberdade, cuidado e qualidade de vida para milhões de brasileiros. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita por gente que faz bem e que está comprometida em levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país e, hoje, somos quase 1.700 lojas e mais de 28 mil colaboradores que formam uma comunidade diversa que cresce junto e trabalha com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Nossa história começou em 1981, com a abertura da primeira loja em Fortaleza (CE). Desde então, seguimos crescendo com base na valorização das pessoas, no foco no cliente, na sustentabilidade, na integridade, na superação dos resultados e na inovação em soluções de saúde. Hoje somos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil , que é fruto de uma estratégia que combina eficiência, proximidade com o cliente e fortalecimento dos nossos consultórios farmacêuticos.

Nosso modelo de negócio une produtos, serviços e cuidado contínuo. Atuamos no varejo de especialidade com o conceito de drugstore e evoluímos para um hub integrado de saúde.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, incentiva a autenticidade e acredita no poder da colaboração. É um lugar para crescer, contribuir e gerar impacto todos os dias. Bora juntos?

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/Node.js)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
  • Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed.
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, code quality, code reviews and operational excellence.
  • Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets.
  • Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs.
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, with a strong understanding of design patterns.
  • Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM).
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools.
  • Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.g., Jest, Gatling, Playwright).
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with product managers, designers, and engineers in a remote-friendly environment.
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Experience with native mobile development (Android and/or iOS), including the respective SDKs and app release workflows.
  • Experience with AWS and working with databases.
  • Experience with SDUI and CI/CD.
  • Experience with flutter_bloc.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Arquitetura de Rede AWS - 132142
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Rede/AWS).

Responsabilidades:

Profissional especializado em segurança para ambientes financeiros críticos, responsável por definir, especializado em conectividade híbrida e ambientes de baixa latência, responsável por projetar e validar arquitetura de rede entre AWS e ambientes on-premises, garantindo desempenho, resiliência e segurança para cargas de trabalho do PIX. Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.

  • Projetar arquitetura de conectividade híbrida (AWS e on-prem);
  • Definir estratégia de conectividade (Direct Connect, failover via VPN);
  • Planejar e validar testes de performance de rede (latência, jitter, perda de pacotes);
  • Projetar arquitetura VPC com sub-redes segmentadas;
  • Otimizar tráfego de rede para workloads críticos;
  • Definir estratégias multirregião e de recuperação de desastres;
  • Implementar mecanismos de alta disponibilidade e failover;
  • Integrar rede com plataformas de containers (EKS/ROSA);
  • Colaborar com equipes de segurança para proteção de rede

Requisitos :

  • Amazon VPC, AWS Transit Gateway, Route 53;
  • AWS Direct Connect e VPN;
  • Network Load Balancer (Camada 4);
  • VPC Flow Logs e observabilidade de rede;
  • BGP e roteamento avançado;
  • Arquitetura de alto desempenho e baixa latência;
  • Certificações: AWS Network Specialty.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com sistemas financeiros e de missão crítica;
  • Operação de ambientes com alto throughput (milhares de TPS);
  • Estratégias de failover ativo-ativo;
  • Considerações de rede para integração com HSM.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

title: Senior Electrical BIM Engineer
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:

Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Continuing Education
  • Sports & Fitness
  • Fully remote work
  • Healthy work–life balance
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Perform hands-on VDC and Electrical BIM production, including modeling, coordination, shop drawings, and prefabrication deliverables.
  • Ensure all work complies with design intent, NEC codes, and client requirements.
  • Take full ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables with minimal supervision.
  • Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues and support the development of coordination-ready drawings.
  • Manage tasks, project schedules, and internal deadlines effectively.
  • Participate in client coordination meetings to align design intent, standards, and technical requirements.
  • Support RFIs and technical clarifications as required.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Maintain strong proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, Evolve, and other required VDC tools.


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with mentoring experience
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused
  • Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Continuing Education
  • Sports & Fitness
  • Fully remote work
  • Healthy work–life balance
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Perform hands-on VDC and Electrical BIM production, including modeling, coordination, shop drawings, and prefabrication deliverables.
  • Ensure all work complies with design intent, NEC codes, and client requirements.
  • Take full ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables with minimal supervision.
  • Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues and support the development of coordination-ready drawings.
  • Manage tasks, project schedules, and internal deadlines effectively.
  • Participate in client coordination meetings to align design intent, standards, and technical requirements.
  • Support RFIs and technical clarifications as required.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Maintain strong proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, Evolve, and other required VDC tools.


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with mentoring experience
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused
  • Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js) | Integração
description:

Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.

Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.


Qualificações

  • Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção
  • Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
  • Domínio de frameworks como NestJS e/ou Next.js
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
  • Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
  • Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
  • Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
  • Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz


Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


Atribuições:

  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • We are building a team to work on the FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) framework, including hwmon, libpmc, and pmcstat.
  • The project includes development, testing, and cooperation with the upstream FreeBSD open-source community to integrate new features into FreeBSD.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and improve parts of the FreeBSD PMC framework (hwmon, libpmc, pmcstat)
  • Investigate and fix performance and monitoring issues in the FreeBSD kernel
  • Work with the upstream FreeBSD community and integrate changes into mainline FreeBSD
  • Support performance monitoring tools for modern AMD (Zen era) hardware
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7 years of experience in relevant technical areas
  • Strong knowledge of FreeBSD kernel architecture and internals
  • Excellent C programming skills
  • Strong understanding of x86 microarchitecture
  • Very good knowledge of performance monitoring on modern x86 systems


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Previous contributions to upstream FreeBSD kernel code
  • Experience with AMD Zen performance monitoring technologies (PMC, IBS, etc.)

title: Front End Technical lead-AI
description:
• Technical Lead, AI and Engineering
  • 100% Remote LATAM

This is a combination of Lead, Front end - React and Next JS hands on development, and Generative AI

Candidates should have been at a Lead capacity overseeing multiple projects. They could be a people manager as well - but should be hands on with development

Candidates have to clear React Hacker Rank coding test

Our client is building a scalable, AI-enabled platform that helps founders turn ideas into real ventures. As a Tech Lead, you’ll play a key role in shaping the core architecture and AI infrastructure, with real ownership over how the platform is designed, built, and scaled.

Job Description

Job Summary:

Lead development and implementation of complex information technology projects and architecture to solve problems with wide impact, requiring high levels of functional integration.

The Technical Lead acts as the primary architectural authority and engineering manager for the platform. This hands-on role is responsible for architecting scalable technical solutions, managing the engineering team, and working closely with the Product Team and Business Leadership to build AI-powered tools that deliver measurable value.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Technical Architecture & Strategy

  • Architect, design, and provide hands-on contribution to the development and deployment of scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions that support business goals and product initiatives.
  • Make technical design choices and follow technical standards, including cyber security, software languages, tools, and infrastructure.
  • Balance fast, lean innovation with practical implementation, technical feasibility, technical debt, and system stability in production environments.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their applicability to platform needs and understand risk mitigation strategies.

Engineering Leadership & Priorities

  • Manage the engineering team in alignment with product roadmap and critical deadlines.
  • Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical specs and engineering tasks.
  • Mentor software developers, conduct code reviews, and ensure high-quality coding.
  • Oversee the software product development lifecycle, including MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and release management, as well as data pipelines, and governance.

Product Collaboration

  • Partner with the Product Team, Designers, and Business Director to align on strategic priorities, estimate development effort, and define timelines.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders including executives and customers.

Ethics & Risk Management

  • Ensure responsible data management and AI practices (fairness, transparency, and data privacy) and ensure governance frameworks for AI model deployment and monitoring.
  • Navigate regulatory requirements, security needs, and compliance consideration.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

Additional Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field
  • 8+ years of Software Engineering (ideally AI-focused) experience, including 2+ years in a Lead Engineer, Architect, or equivalent technical leadership role

Core Technical Expertise:

Deep understanding of and strong hands-on experience with:

  • Application & Product Engineering
  • Modern web application architecture, including frontend, middleware, backend, and full-stack development
  • Languages and frameworks including Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, NextJS, React, Node.js, and SQL
  • APIs, Services & Data
  • Microservices and API design, including REST and GraphQL
  • Asynchronous and event-driven systems
  • Authentication and authorization
  • Data and storage systems (relational, NoSQL, and vector databases)
  • Cloud Platforms & Infrastructure
  • Cloud-native and distributed systems design
  • Containerization and orchestration (e.g., Terraform, Docker)
  • AWS , including Bedrock, SageMaker, EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, and IAM
  • Additional cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) and cloud-agnostic design principles
  • DevOps, MLOps & Delivery
  • CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code
  • Model deployment, monitoring, and operational reliability

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.

title: Especialista em Sistemas Corporativos - Turismo
description:
Somos o ecossistema de turismo mais transformador na vida de cada pessoa! A paixão por viagens está em nosso DNA.


Nossos escritórios proporcionam um ambiente moderno e pensado para uma melhor experiência de trabalho presencial. Somos múltiplos e diversos, gostamos de trabalhar com gente do bem, de forma inteligente, prática, ousada, inovadora e com tudo isso, buscamos o extraordinário.


O que nos move é a transformação e nosso lema é criar caminhos além do imaginável! Isso nos torna BeFly. E aí, você vem com a gente?


#VemSerBeFly


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar como referência funcional e evolutiva do ERP Benner Turismo, garantindo estabilidade operacional, evolução do produto e alinhamento entre negócio, tecnologia e fornecedores. Papel híbrido, com forte atuação como Product Owner, priorizando backlog, melhorias e entregas de valor.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Ser o ponto focal do ERP Benner (módulos financeiros, faturamento, conciliação, backoffice e integrações).
  • Atuar como Product Owner do produto, com gestão de backlog, priorização e roadmap.
  • Levantar e traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais claros.
  • Conduzir refinamentos, homologações e apoiar testes (UAT).
  • Garantir qualidade das entregas, estabilidade e aderência aos processos do negócio.
  • Interface direta com áreas usuárias, fornecedores (Benner) e times técnicos.
  • Apoiar projetos de automação, melhorias contínuas e integrações (APIs, arquivos, RPA).
  • Monitorar indicadores, riscos e impactos operacionais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com ERP Benner (preferencialmente Benner Turismo).
  • Vivência em áreas financeiras/administrativas e processos de backoffice.
  • Atuação prévia ou forte aderência ao papel de Product Owner.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de priorização.
  • Perfil hands-on, colaborativo e orientado a entrega.
  • Experiência com projetos, backlog, indicadores e condução de demandas com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Desejável conhecimento em Power BI, integrações e automação de processos


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFly?


  • VR iFood Benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com coparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Estacionamento na sede | Desconto exclusivo para colaboradores.

title: Account Executive
description:
Company Description

Metrobi provides a fulfillment platform designed specifically for local businesses, empowering them to streamline delivery management and improve customer communication. The platform connects businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizes in-house delivery operation efficiency. Dedicated to supporting local food and beverage makers, Metrobi offers logistics tools to help expand their distribution networks. Metrobi makes delivery simpler, helping businesses grow with confidence and strengthen their local impact.


Account Executive


This is a remote, full-cycle Account Executive position focused on driving revenue by managing the entire sales process, from prospecting to closing, over the phone and via video conferences. You will manage a territory, conduct product demonstrations, and negotiate contracts to meet revenue targets. 


Responsibilities


  • Full-Cycle Sales: Own the entire sales process, from identifying prospects to closing deals.
  • Prospecting & Outreach: Execute targeted multi-touch inbound and outbound campaigns (phone, email) to generate your own pipeline.
  • Product Demos & Closing: Conduct high-impact virtual product demonstrations and presentations.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Negotiate contracts and finalize agreements to meet quarterly and annual sales quotas.
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain an accurate CRM system (e.g., HubSpot) with detailed activity notes and forecasting. 


 Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an Account Executive, Sales Representative, or relevant role (closing experience preferred).
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong experience with CRM software and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

title: Data Scientist Tech Lead
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Scientist Tech Lead who wants to learn and transform his career.


Mandatory Skills :

  • SAFe We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with extensive experience in Python, Machine Learning , and advanced knowledge of AWS components to lead data analytics projects and the development of scalable solutions.
  • Technologies such as Deep Learning and GenAI will be considered a plus.
  • Knowledge of GenAI (LLMs, Prompt Engineering, APIs such as OpenAI, HuggingFace) is important.


Desirable Skills:

  • Experience with Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience with multimodal models. Experience with the technology called Kedro.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields.
  • Experience: Advanced programming in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
  • Development and implementation of Machine Learning models at scale.
  • Solid experience with AWS components (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, EC2, IAM).
  • Experience in technical leadership or team mentoring.
  • Additional skills: Handling large volumes of data. Knowledge of SQL and relational/non-relational databases. Good MLOps and CI/CD practices for models.
  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of Machine Learning models for complex applications. Structure robust and scalable data pipelines, ensuring quality and performance.
  • Define architecture and integrate solutions with AWS services (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, EC2, IAM).
  • Act as a technical reference, guiding teams and ensuring best practices.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.
  • Document processes and promote versioning, testing, and deployment standards.


Keywords:

  • Python, Machine Learning; componentes AWS

title: Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de Financeiro Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time Financeiro e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de contas a pagar e receber, incluindo execução de pagamentos;
  • Realização de conciliações bancárias, garantindo a acuracidade das informações;
  • Atualização e controle do fluxo de caixa, assegurando o correto registro das movimentações financeiras;
  • Execução de rotinas financeiras recorrentes com alto volume de transações e prazos definidos;
  • Organização e arquivamento de documentos financeiros e fiscais;
  • Execução e suporte no processo de faturamento e emissão de notas fiscais, incluindo tratamento de inconsistências;
  • Execução de rotinas administrativas e compras corporativas;
  • Gestão e controle de contratos;
  • Execução e suporte ativo no fechamento contábil, com envio de informações e realização de conciliações financeiras;
  • Execução de validações e suporte às auditorias financeiras;
  • Interface com áreas internas e fornecedores para resolução de pendências financeiras;
  • Identificação, análise e resolução de inconsistências financeiras, com proposição de melhorias;
  • Garantir a execução ponta a ponta das rotinas financeiras sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das informações financeiras.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida com rotinas financeiras e administrativas (conciliação, controle e análise de dados);
  • Conhecimento em relatórios financeiros e controles internos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel/Google Sheets;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Power BI;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Perfil proativo, analítico, com boa gestão do tempo e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ERP financeiro (ex: Omie, Conta Azul, SAP, etc.);
  • Experiência construindo dashboards financeiros;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre tributos;
  • Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento ou startups;
  • Experiência prévia com processos de fechamento contábil e auditoria;
  • Experiência com melhoria contínua e otimização de processos financeiros.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Cientista de Dados SR
description:
Atividades

  • Atuar em todas as etapas do ciclo de vida de ciência de dados: coleta, tratamento, modelagem, validação, deploy e monitoramento de modelos.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de Machine Learning (treinamento, inferência, versionamento e automação).
  • Implementar pipelines de MLOps e LLMOps, incluindo CI/CD, controle de versionamento de dados, prompts e modelos e monitoramento de performance.
  • Desenvolver soluções em Python, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software e reprodutibilidade.
  • Construir e otimizar pipelines de dados integrando fontes diversas, garantindo qualidade e governança.
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos e técnicas de aprendizado supervisionado e não supervisionado para resolver problemas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de engenharia, produto e negócio, traduzindo desafios técnicos em resultados mensuráveis.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em projetos de ciência de dados aplicados a negócios.
  • Domínio em Python e bibliotecas de ciência de dados (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experiência prática com MLOps (implementação de pipelines de ML, CI/CD, versionamento de modelos, deploy e monitoramento em produção).
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e manipulação de bases de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência com modelagem estatística e métricas de desempenho de modelos.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados (Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau ou similares).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Vertex AI Model Garden, experimentação com Gemini e tuning de modelos via Vertex AI.
  • Certificações em Machine Learning, MLOps ou pipelines de ML em nuvem.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de orquestração e versionamento (Airflow, MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em integração com modelos de linguagem (LLMs), cache de prompts e otimização de custos de inferência de LLMs.
  • Familiaridade com Red Teaming para LLMs e implementação de guardrails de segurança (Content Safety API).
  • Experiência em deploy de modelos em containers utilizando Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) ou Cloud Run.
  • Espanhol ou inglês avançado.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

  • Implementar pipelines de MLOps e LLMOps, incluindo CI/CD, controle de versionamento de dados, prompts e modelos e monitoramento de performance.
  • Desenvolver soluções em Python, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software e reprodutibilidade.
  • Construir e otimizar pipelines de dados integrando fontes diversas, garantindo qualidade e governança.
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos e técnicas de aprendizado supervisionado e não supervisionado para resolver problemas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de engenharia, produto e negócio, traduzindo desafios técnicos em resultados mensuráveis.


Requisitos

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview


We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
  • Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable patterns for:
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Pull request automation
  • Test generation
  • Debugging workflows
  • Developer self-service enablement
  • Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Manage AI usage governance, including:
  • Token budgeting and cost controls
  • Usage monitoring and reporting
  • PII redaction guardrails
  • Audit logging and responsible AI practices
  • Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Integrate AI tooling into GitLab CI/CD, GitOps workflows, and developer platforms .
  • Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
  • Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/SaaS tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
  • Practical daily usage of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT , or similar.
  • Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
  • Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
  • Bedrock
  • API Gateway
  • Managed AI/Cloud Services
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence .
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM Agents
  • RAG pipelines
  • Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Exposure to AI FinOps , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
  • Knowledge of AI governance and security , including:
  • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
  • Prompt injection risks
  • Model supply chain security
  • Responsible AI controls
  • Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
  • Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable patterns for:
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Pull request automation
  • Test generation
  • Debugging workflows
  • Developer self-service enablement
  • Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Manage AI usage governance, including:
  • Token budgeting and cost controls
  • Usage monitoring and reporting
  • PII redaction guardrails
  • Audit logging and responsible AI practices
  • Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Integrate AI tooling into GitLab CI/CD, GitOps workflows, and developer platforms .
  • Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.

  • API Gateway

  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).

  • LLM Agents

  • Exposure to AI FinOps , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.

  • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
  • Prompt injection risks
  • Model supply chain security
  • Responsible AI controls
  • Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
WeMaster Trade is a rapidly scaling fintech company operating in the trading space, connecting traders, partners, and affiliates across global markets. We move fast, think big, and focus on results. Our mission is to build a powerful ecosystem of strategic partnerships that drive growth and create long-term value. We are seeking a strategic and relationship-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team. In this role, you will focus on identifying, developing, and managing high-value partnerships that drive sustainable growth. You will play a key role in expanding our network of partners, affiliates, and strategic collaborators across global markets.


Responsibilities:

• Identify and engage potential strategic partners, affiliates, and business opportunities aligned with our growth objectives.

• Develop and nurture long-term relationships with partners, acting as a trusted point of contact.

• Evaluate partnership opportunities and build proposals that align with mutual business goals.

• Collaborate with internal teams (sales, marketing, operations) to execute and optimize partnership strategies.

• Support onboarding of new partners, ensuring a smooth and successful integration into our platform.

• Monitor partner performance and identify opportunities to maximize value and revenue.

• Maintain accurate records of partnerships, communications, and pipeline activity in CRM systems.

• Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support expansion strategies.


Qualifications:

• 1–3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or account management roles.

• Strong communication skills in English (professional level).

• Strategic mindset with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

• Ability to manage multiple partnerships and priorities simultaneously.

• Experience using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).

• Analytical thinking with a focus on long-term growth and value creation.

• Experience in fintech, trading, brokerage, affiliate programs, or digital platforms is a strong advantage.


What We Offer:

• Opportunity to work on high-impact strategic initiatives

• Ongoing professional development and career growth

• Collaborative and international work environment

• Exposure to global markets and partnership ecosystems


Job Type : Full-Time / Remote

Salary : $800 USD/month + Commission

description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com ServiceNow.

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas utilizando ServiceNow App Engine

  • CSS
  • JavaScript

  • Atuação próxima com áreas de negócio para levantamento e entendimento de requisitos

  • Sólida experiência em:

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

title: Analista de Negócios Pleno
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO


  • Levantar e documentar requisitos de negócio para novas funcionalidades e projetos.
  • Redigir histórias de usuários detalhadas, alinhadas às necessidades do cliente interno.
  • Analisar integrações e tecnologias, propondo soluções práticas e escaláveis.
  • Ser o ponto focal para dúvidas sobre processos de desenvolvimento e soluções voltadas para o mercado de seguros.
  • Redesenhar processos existentes, otimizando fluxos e resultados.
  • Identificar e mapear oportunidades de mercado, propondo melhorias estratégicas.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA


  • Experiência no setor de seguros: Vivência em corretoras ou seguradoras.
  • Experiência com Ferramentas do Google Workspace em nível intermediário (Sheets, Docs, etc.).
  • Desejável experiência com Jira e familiaridade com integrações tecnológicas.
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade, organização e transparência para atuar de forma colaborativa.
  • Ensino superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER


  • Conhecimento avançado sobre práticas e tendências do setor de seguros.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PRA VOCÊ


️ Auxílio Alimentação : para você escolher suas refeições com liberdade.

Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos.

Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais.

Assistência Médica SulAmérica : Cuidado completo para você e sua família.

title: Analista de Negócios Pleno
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO


  • Levantar e documentar requisitos de negócio para novas funcionalidades e projetos.
  • Redigir histórias de usuários detalhadas, alinhadas às necessidades do cliente interno.
  • Analisar integrações e tecnologias, propondo soluções práticas e escaláveis.
  • Ser o ponto focal para dúvidas sobre processos de desenvolvimento e soluções voltadas para o mercado de seguros.
  • Redesenhar processos existentes, otimizando fluxos e resultados.
  • Identificar e mapear oportunidades de mercado, propondo melhorias estratégicas.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA


  • Experiência no setor de seguros: Vivência em corretoras ou seguradoras.
  • Experiência com Ferramentas do Google Workspace em nível intermediário (Sheets, Docs, etc.).
  • Desejável experiência com Jira e familiaridade com integrações tecnológicas.
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade, organização e transparência para atuar de forma colaborativa.

title: Vendedor(a) Pleno
description:
A Schalter busca um profissional com maturidade comercial, capacidade de negociação, repertório consultivo e foco em performance para atuar na venda de soluções tecnológicas, desde a identificação da oportunidade até o fechamento e expansão da carteira.


Fundada em 1991, a Schalter é referência em soluções completas de autoatendimento e self-checkout, com um ecossistema que inclui hardware, software, implantação, suporte técnico on site, monitoramento remoto, locação e outsourcing. Nosso propósito é ajudar nossos clientes a satisfazer seus próprios clientes, com tecnologia, eficiência e inovação.


Esta posição exige capacidade de diagnóstico comercial, condução de reuniões estratégicas, negociação de propostas e desenvolvimento de contas, em uma operação orientada a resultado.


Responsabilidades

●      Prospectar novos clientes e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio

●      Realizar reuniões e apresentações comerciais

●      Identificar necessidades e dores dos clientes

●      Apresentar soluções tecnológicas aderentes ao cenário de cada conta

●      Elaborar, conduzir e negociar propostas comerciais

●      Fechar vendas e apoiar a expansão da carteira

●      Manter relacionamento com clientes e stakeholders

●      Atualizar CRM, controles e sistemas internos

●      Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas para garantir fluidez no processo comercial

●      Antecipar riscos e sugerir melhorias contínuas na operação comercial

Requisitos

●      Experiência comprovada em vendas e negociação

●      Vivência com atendimento ao cliente e relacionamento comercial

●      Boa comunicação verbal e escrita

●      Capacidade de negociação e condução de fechamento

●      Organização, planejamento e gestão de pipeline comercial

●      Perfil orientado a metas e resultados


Diferenciais

●      Experiência com venda de soluções tecnológicas

●      Conhecimento em produtos de informática

●      Familiaridade com terminais de autoatendimento, self-checkout e softwares aplicativos

●      Formação em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, TI ou áreas afins


Remuneração e condições

●      Salário fixo compatível com formação, experiência e escopo do cargo

●      Remuneração variável/comissão conforme performance

●      Benefícios informados ao longo do processo seletivo, conforme política interna da empresa

●      Jornada presencial, em tempo integral, em Cachoeirinha/RS


Se você quer atuar em uma empresa com proposta de valor robusta, venda consultiva e espaço para geração real de resultado, a Schalter quer conhecer o seu perfil.

title: Analista de Modelagem de Dados
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa para liderar a modelagem conceitual do domínio em contexto industrial, conectando arquitetura de dados a necessidades de negócio. Será responsável por entender projetos, abstrair processos e estruturar a camada de domínio e os use cases, colaborando com times multifuncionais e globais.


Principais atividades:

  • Conduzir a modelagem conceitual do domínio no contexto industrial, definindo entidades, relacionamentos e limites de contexto.
  • Derivar e estruturar use cases e modelos de domínio com base na arquitetura de dados corporativa.
  • Entender projetos e requisitos, abstrair processos e mapear para a camada de domínio e casos de uso.
  • Assegurar consistência e governança dos modelos, facilitando discussões técnicas com times globais.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em modelagem conceitual de dados e de domínio, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais.
  • Vivência em traduzir arquitetura de dados em modelos de domínio e casos de uso de negócio e técnicos.
  • Forte capacidade de abstração, comunicação e facilitação entre negócio, dados e engenharia.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (participação ativa em reuniões e workshops com times globais).


Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação remota
